fusion_assessment.summary: Existing Clay already had recursive live refresh, live-web evidence fusion and a v0.2 candidate for dependency-aware worker-delta routing. The owner direction adds a stronger missing cross-cutting contract: all newly observed available data sources enter one provenance-bound intake, and every material semantic delta must close a research-reentry loop back into evidence, hypotheses/counterhypotheses, experiments, architecture, tests, work and affected branches.
fusion_assessment.strongest_counterhypothesis: A universal all-source fusion layer could create excessive context, coordination cost, false materiality and correlated groupthink. Therefore raw observations remain indexed/pullable, materiality is explicit, contradictions remain unresolved until evidence discriminates them, and adaptive routing remains evidence-gated rather than globally promoted by decree.

fresh_external_evidence.title: Enzyme: Incremental View Maintenance for Data Engineering
fresh_external_evidence.relevance: Supports cost-based selection among incremental refresh strategies rather than one fixed refresh mode; confirms the existing v0.2 adaptive-routing direction but does not by itself promote it.

fresh_external_evidence.title: Differential Dataflow
fresh_external_evidence.relevance: Supports maintaining computations as input data change, logical-time update handling and reusable indexed arrangements for changing data.

fresh_external_evidence.title: Layph: Making Change Propagation Constraint in Incremental Graph Processing by Layering Graph
fresh_external_evidence.relevance: Counterpressure against naive locality: even small graph changes can propagate globally, so dense/global invalidations and bounded propagation controls must remain available.

fresh_external_evidence.title: Dotted Version Vectors: Logical Clocks for Optimistic Replication
fresh_external_evidence.relevance: Supports concise causal/concurrency tracking for distributed update histories and motivates preserving causal predecessors without imposing unnecessary total global order.

test_obligations: targeted affected-branch recall and false-interrupt rate
no truth/effect-authority inflation from ingestion, graph activation or distribution
next_falsifier: Execute real current-repo source/research replay plus fault/recovery matrix and show that mandatory re-entry closes material deltas without excessive false materiality, stale propagation, context flood or worse resource/correctness tradeoffs than simpler baselines.
